title: Appliances installed in rooms that are not large in comparison with the size of the appliance.
officialText:
Central-heating furnaces
and low-pressure boilers installed in rooms that are not large in comparison with the size of the appliance, such as alcoves and closets,
shall be listed for such installations. Listed clearances shall not be reduced by the protection methods described in Table 3 08.2 and
illustrated in Figures 308.2(1) through 308.2(3), regardless of whether the enclosure is of combustible or noncombustible material.
